original.target_description: Study 2: constraint/expense size and relative efficiency versus priority planning. Appendix E describes the planning-mix ANOVA, ordinal-position ANOVA, response-time model and plan-probability models; supplied main-article p. 6 locator cannot be checked in this appendix alone.

n.sample_role: Participants for the planning-mix ANOVA; no explicit analytic participant count supplied. Response-time and plan-probability models additionally involve repeated responses within participants.
n.exclusions: No explicit final participant counts, mutually exclusive final group counts or participant exclusion accounting are supplied in this appendix.
n.location: Appendix E, p. 1, Change in Planning Mix as a Function of Constraint: Analytical Details; pp. 2–4 additional Study 2 models inspected
n.quote:
For the analysis of how the planning mix changed with
constraint, we ran an ANOVA with plan type as a within subject factor (priority vs. efficiency) and constraint level as a
between subject factor (low vs. medium vs. high).

notes: Identity assessment: supplied text identifies Appendix E from Fernbach, Kan, and Lynch, “Squeezed: Coping with Constraint through Efficiency and Prioritization”, JCR vol. 41 no. 5, with copyright 2014 and DOI 10.1086/679118, matching the assigned original reference. This is a primary published supplemental appendix, not the full main article; it contains four numbered pages of Study 2 analytical details. No PDF was supplied. Assigned field n_o only; all other statistic fields and the replication/success records are unassigned placeholders. No explicit analytic N or final group counts appear in the inspected appendix. The planning-mix ANOVA prints denominator df 99, but N is not derived from df. No arithmetic performed. Main-article p. 6 is unavailable within this permitted source, so exact target-test correspondence remains unverified. Candidate analyses are planning-mix, average ordinal position, response times, and plan-generation probabilities; no candidate is selected by numeric matching.
